sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def snap(f):
    d={}
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        c=n['color']
        if c in ('N','W','G','c','b','g'):
            xs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]; ys=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]
            d.setdefault(c,[]).append((min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs),n['pixels']))
    return d
res = action(['DOWN','LEFT','LEFT','SPACE'])
s=snap(current_frame)
print("N",s.get('N')); print("W",s.get('W')); print("G",s.get('G')); print("c",s.get('c'))
print("done/level:", last_action_result.get('done'), last_action_result.get('level_completed'), last_action_result.get('reward'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
